effective admission: unknown, unverified, expired, revoked and other UID denied; own verified active allowed
pause affects direct SDK and all private subtrees, independent of frontend; validated results immutable
admission requires verified Auth, cap survives concurrent operators, erased UID cannot rejoin
UID export and deletion include nested backups/derived data; retain fence, protect B and guest, remove managed archives
shared UID references block erasure; inventory caps fail without claiming completeness; monitor pause is effective
cross-owner UID fields become review blockers, not deletion authority
offline queued writes cannot replay after administrative erasure fence
